alt_screen_47.reason: Mode ?47 (switch to the alternate screen, no clear, no cursor save) is not implemented in alacritty_terminal, so 'alt' lands on the main screen. xterm and avt keep it off the main screen. vt100 also restores the cursor, which xterm does not do for ?47. Not fixed here.
problems: oracles disagree: cursor (row, col, hidden): avt=(0, 7, false) vt100=(0, 4, false)
vtee vs avt: row 0 text, first difference at col 4: vtee="mainalt             " avt="main                "
vtee vs vt100: row 0 text, first difference at col 4: vtee="mainalt             " vt100="main                "

alt_screen_stays.reason: ?1049h saves the cursor and switches screens without moving the cursor; vt100 homes it.
problems: oracles disagree: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: avt="                    " vt100="alt                 "
vtee vs vt100: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: vtee="                    " vt100="alt                 "

autowrap_off.reason: With ?7l, text past the last column overwrites it instead of wrapping; vt100 wraps anyway.
problems: oracles disagree: row 1 text, first difference at col 0: avt="                    " vt100="xxxxx               "
vtee vs vt100: row 1 text, first difference at col 0: vtee="                    " vt100="xxxxx               "

combining_mark.reason: A combining mark attaches to the previous cell (x stays in column 1). avt gives the mark a cell of its own and shifts x right; vt100 agrees with vtee.
problems: oracles disagree: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: avt="e\u{301}x                 " vt100="e\u{301}x                  "
vtee vs avt: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: vtee="e\u{301}x                  " avt="e\u{301}x                 "

dec_special_graphics.reason: ESC ( 0 selects line drawing; vt100 has no charset support.

vtee vs vt100: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: vtee="┌──┐                " vt100="lqqk                "

erase_display_above.reason: ED 1 (CSI 1 J) must erase from the top of the screen to the cursor. alacritty_terminal 0.26.0 only clears the lines above when cursor.line > 1, so with the cursor on the second row the first row survives. Both oracles agree with xterm. Fix needs a change in or around alacritty_terminal; not fixed here.

vtee vs vt100: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: vtee="AAAA                " vt100="                    "

index_and_nel.reason: ESC D (IND) and ESC E (NEL) are standard; vt100 ignores both.

insert_mode.reason: CSI 4 h (IRM) inserts instead of overwriting; vt100 ignores it.

origin_mode.reason: In xterm both setting and resetting DECOM (?6) homes the cursor. alacritty_terminal homes it on set but not on reset, so the cursor stays at (1, 1) instead of (0, 0). Not fixed here.
problems: vtee vs avt: cursor (row, col, hidden): vtee=(1, 1, false) avt=(0, 0, false)
vtee vs vt100: cursor (row, col, hidden): vtee=(1, 1, false) vt100=(0, 0, false)

repeat_char.reason: CSI n b (REP) repeats the last character in xterm; vt100 lacks it.
problems: oracles disagree: row 0 text, first difference at col 1: avt="aaaaaa              " vt100="a                   "
vtee vs vt100: row 0 text, first difference at col 1: vtee="aaaaaa              " vt100="a                   "

resize_grow_rows.reason: Growing the screen pulls scrolled-off lines back into view (xterm does this; so does avt). vt100 keeps no history for this to restore.
problems: oracles disagree: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: avt="1         " vt100="3         "
vtee vs vt100: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: vtee="1         " vt100="3         "

resize_shrink_cols.reason: Shrinking the width re-wraps long lines in alacritty, VTE and kitty (vtee and avt do the same); xterm and vt100 truncate instead. vtee inherits alacritty_terminal's reflow, so an xterm-based golden would differ.
problems: oracles disagree: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: avt="klmnopqrst" vt100="abcdefghij"
vtee vs vt100: row 0 text, first difference at col 0: vtee="klmnopqrst" vt100="abcdefghij"

save_restore_cursor_csi.reason: CSI s / CSI u save and restore the cursor in xterm; vt100 lacks them.

vtee vs vt100: row 0 text, first difference at col 2: vtee="abcd                " vt100="ab                  "

tab_default_stops.reason: A tab writes a literal TAB character into the cell where it starts, so snapshot text contains TAB where xterm and both oracles have a blank. Positions are right. A mapping fix in snapshot.rs (render TAB as a space) would close it; not fixed here.
